086b99ebe73d33bf.name: setup_chest_open_camera
086b99ebe73d33bf.doc: Queues the camera and actor records for the treasure chest opening: an actor plays the get motion while the camera moves in.

1aee32045ddb111e.name: do_nothing
1aee32045ddb111e.doc: Empty placeholder used where a script needs a call that does nothing.

4f8ace1933a7211a.name: register_scene_camera_records
4f8ace1933a7211a.doc: Registers argument records for event scenes 700 to 3200: two camera points per scene id plus actor start positions and yaw. Pure data setup, no waiting.

79cb6c3780138c77.name: define_scene_placements
79cb6c3780138c77.doc: Defines, for each scene id from 700 to 3200, two camera point records and the actor placement records (actor slot, position and facing) used by the event.

a9ea35f2079308d6.name: build_test_args
a9ea35f2079308d6.doc: Adds four argument records at 50 to 80, sets the record id to 100 and adds a record holding the walk motion name and the number 2.
